person_note: The controlling narration is third-person limited, centered on Noemí. Several Goodreads passages expose that external position through attributed thought and free-indirect access to her feelings, while many other quotes are dialogue, aphorisms, or too grammatically unmarked to diagnose person. First- and second-person pronouns in the dialogue are local character speech, not autonomous narrative sections. The authorized opening excerpt and Purdue's whole-book instructional analysis agree, and targeted research found no credible alternating structure; the opening source's limited scope is resolved by the whole-book evidence.
